notes.title: Club Bifrost Ver1.12a Update
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for a great launch week! The doors of Club Bifrost will continue to be open up for you!

There has been reports of Monster Girl Club Bifrost being falsely flagged by certain antivirus programs as a virus. As long as you downloaded all your files from Steam, the files should be safe as long as they are not modified! ːlunar2019piginablanketː

Please let your friends and their pet animals know that Monster Girl Club Bifrost is virus-free and available on Steam! And also check out our game catalog on our website at: https://remtairy.com/

Our next upcoming on Steam will be Island SAGA, developed by the lovely Kamichichi and also published and localized by us! Please wishlist Island SAGA on Steam after you finish writing a review for Club Bifrost! ːlovewaveː

And with that all said, here's the changelog for Club BIfrost v1.12a:

Changelog
[list]
[*]Fixed the game freezing when the clients get way too satisfied.
[*]Fixed the training buttons being grayed out even when the monster girl has stamina.
[*]Made the number animation go by a bit faster during Night Phase when the numbers are really high.
[*]Fixed a display error with club experience when clients extend their time.
[*]Made the maximum amount of Mood that can be gained during Night Phase to 100.
[*]Minor bugs and typos fixed.
[/list]

Please restart Steam to download the v1.12a update!

Website - https://remtairy.com/
Twitter - https://twitter.com/Remtairy
Discord - https://discord.gg/Zb7gG3u
Patreon https://www.patreon.com/remtairy

notes.title: Club Bifrost v1.11f
notes.content:
Monster Girl Club Bifrost is only 30% off until the end of this weekend! Now is the time to tell all your friends and family members and distant friends and distant family members and distant family members' friends about the lovely world and girls of Club Bifrost! ːlovewaveː 

Changelog
[list]
[*]Fixed the Exchange Room behaving weirdly for some people.
[*]Fixed client's demand not being displayed properly when they want more than 5 stars.
[*]Fixed a crashing bug related to charmed clients.
[*]Fixed the wrong monster girl type name being displayed when switching monster girls from the reserves to the active group.
[*]Fixed the text in the ending list overlapping when there are too many potential endings. You playboy.
[*]The "Winged" race type has been renamed to "Avian" to hopefully avoid confusion.
[*]Fixed the message that appears when you try to enter an invalid name for a monster girl in the English version.
[*]Minor bugs and typos fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Club Bifrost v1.11e Update
notes.content:
Hello citizens of Bifrost! Have you been working to get that bread today?

Thank you everyone for your continued support! It means so much to use to see everyone enjoying the game we have spent the past year working on to get it localized into English and on Steam. ːlovewaveː And without further ado, here are the changes for v1.11e!

Changelog
[list]
[*]Fixed the Skip button being broken because of the v1.11d update. Milia really gave me an earful last night for this one...
[*]Fixed the pages buttons for the Carry Over screen.
[*]Changed the Lv. indicators for We're Closed and We're Opened sign so that it's less confusing.
[*]Minor bug and typos fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Club Bifrost v1.11d Update

Thank you everyone for playing Monster Girl Club Bifrost!
How have you been enjoying the company of the lovely monster girls of Club Bifrost?

[*]Fixed the text skipping in certain situations even though the Auto Skip Read Text was turned off and the CTRL key wasn't being actively pressed down. As a reminder also, holding down the CTRL will also skip all text if you find your text is skipping!

[*]Fixed the Soft and Hard Training Level displaying incorrectly on the home screen.
[*]Minor bug and typo fixed.
[/list]
